contributions.statement: When evaluating a router that decides which PRs to hand to a repair agent, use only features available at PR creation; full-history features inflated top-20% repair recall from 0.514 to 0.653.
contributions.evidence: Tables 1-2, repository-grouped 5-fold CV on 497 labelled PRs.
relative_to: temporal/target leakage avoidance in ML evaluation

contributions.statement: Gate Dependabot/Renovate PRs with a cheap creation-time classifier and send only the top ~20% to the expensive repair agent; it captured about half of repairs at 2.68 vs 6.90 calls per captured repair.
contributions.evidence: Table 1-2: top-20% recall 0.514, 37/72 repairs; single annotator, repair-enriched pool, exploratory model search; 60-PR pilot measures diagnosis only.

reason: Directly relevant to multi-repo dependency maintenance; the leakage point is a sound evaluation nuance, while the routing gain itself rests on one annotator and 72 positives.
